import java.util.*;

    static final int mo2 = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int[] a = new int[15];
    static int[] b = new int[15];
    static int ans = 0;
    static int[] dif = new int[15];
    static int[] q1 = new int[1000010];
    static int[] q2 = new int[1000010];
    static long[] sq2 = new long[1000010];

    static long dig(int[] b, int l) {
        long re = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= l; i++)
            re = re * 10 + b[i];
        return re;
    }

    static long Rank(int[] b, int l) {
        long ans = 0;
        for (int di = 1; di <= a[0]; di++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(l, di); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < b[i]; j++) {
                    long numl = 0, numr = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++)
                        numl = numr = numl * 10 + b[p];
                    numl = numr = numl * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++)
                        numl = numl * 10;
                    numr = numr * 10 + 9;
                    numr = Math.min(numr, n);
                    if (numl <= numr)
                        ans += numr - numl + 1;
                }
            }
            if (di <= l) ++ans;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int F(int[] a, int di) {
        return (int) (((-dig(a, di) + Rank(a, di)) % mo1 + mo1) % mo1);
    }

    static void dfs(int t, int ed, int[] q, int v, int[] qSize) {
        if (t == ed) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                q[++qSize[0]] = (v + (int) ((long) i * dif[t]) % mo1) % mo1;
            }
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(t + 1, ed, q, (v + (int) ((long) i * dif[t]) % mo1) % mo1, qSize);
        }
    }

    static void update(int di, int i, int j) {
        System.arraycopy(a, 0, b, 0, a.length);
        b[i] = j;
        for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++) b[p] = 0;
        int bas = F(b, di);
        for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++) {
            b[p] = 1;
            dif[p] = (F(b, di) + mo1 - bas) % mo1;
            b[p] = 0;
        }
        if (di - i == 0) {
            ans = (ans + bas) % mo2;
            return;
        }
        if (di - i == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++)
                ans = (ans + (bas + (int) ((long) p * dif[di]) % mo1) % mo1) % mo2;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (di + i) / 2;
        q1[0] = q2[0] = 0;
        int[] q1Size = new int[1];
        int[] q2Size = new int[1];
        dfs(i + 1, mid, q1, bas, q1Size);
        dfs(mid + 1, di, q2, 0, q2Size);
        Arrays.sort(q2, 1, q2[0] + 1);
        long sq2Val = 0;
        for (int p = 1; p <= q2[0]; p++)
            sq2Val = (sq2Val + q2[p]) % mo2;
        for (int p = 1; p <= q1[0]; p++) {
            int target = mo1 - q1[p];
            int pos = lowerBound(q2, 1, q2[0] + 1, target);
            ans = (ans + (int) (sq2Val + (long) q2[0] * q1[p]) % mo2) % mo2;
            ans = (ans + (int) ((long) (q2[0] - pos + 1) * (mo2 - mo1)) % mo2) % mo2;
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int start, int end, int key) {
        int low = start;
        int high = end - 1;
        while (low <= high) {
            int mid = (low + high) >>> 1;
            if (arr[mid] < key)
                low = mid + 1;
            else
                high = mid - 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        int[] temp = new int[15];
        int len = 0;
        long m = n;

            for (int i = 1; i <= di; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (di == a[0] ? a[i] - 1 : 9);

            ans = (ans + F(a, di)) % mo2;

        System.out.println(ans);
